_comment: Bundled default banner set - offline fallback when the configured banner feed is unreachable (isolated server, blocked outbound, CSP block, timeout). The live feed delivers HTML banners that fill the sidepanel's portrait box natively; the fallbacks here are plain text cards (title + text + CTA) so they always render cleanly regardless of sidepanel height, with no cropping. Links must stay on an allowed first-party host configured in banners.allowed_hosts or they are stripped.
